title.zh: 微軟揭露Storm-0940用ARTEX攻破ConnectWise供應鏈、鎖定逾2,250個M365租戶；洛馬Q3財報證實PAC-3產能仍照2030時間表走；川普10/16行政命令無限期豁免對俄《格雷姆法案》制裁，與BIS Affiliates Rule用的是同一套『暫停當籌碼』機制
title.en: Microsoft exposes Storm-0940 using ARTEX to breach ConnectWise's supply chain and target 2,250+ M365 tenants; Lockheed's Q3 earnings confirm PAC-3 capacity still tracks the 2030 timeline; Trump's 10/16 executive order indefinitely waives Graham Act sanctions on Russia, using the same 'suspension-as-leverage' mechanism as the BIS Affiliates Rule

focus.zh: 本期涵蓋10/22-10/24。資安端：微軟資安部落格10/21揭露，中國國家背景駭客集團Storm-0940入侵ConnectWise Cloud Backup多租戶應用的憑證，透過144.172.64.x這組IP對超過2,250個下游M365租戶嘗試登入，部分環境內多個案例在不到3小時內就從初始鎖定推進到具特權存取，期間一度在不到4分鐘內用4組應用程式憑證完成逾200次登入；獨立事件應變廠商Huntress從自家客群觀測到逾1,000個Entra租戶遭鎖定、逾300個確認淪陷，與微軟自家統計形成交叉驗證。攻擊工具正是本站10/10報告收錄的ARTEX——當時記錄的是財務動機駭客串接Claude Code入侵南韓金融機構，這次是同一工具第一次被證實用在國家級行為者的MSP供應鏈規模攻擊上。另外，PHP核心團隊10/21緊急修補兩個CVSS 9.2的未經驗證遠端程式碼執行漏洞(CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619，媒體稱『PHP2Shell』)，幾乎所有PHP版本都受影響，廠商評估潛在曝險達全球PHP網站的七成，watchTowr已獨立重現其中一個漏洞，多家資安廠商觀測到修補當天就有掃描與攻擊嘗試，但尚無證實的大規模淪陷案例。軍工端：洛克希德馬丁10/22公布Q3 2026財報，積壓訂單再創新高來到2,920億美元(較Q2的2,304億美元再跳升)，其中525億美元是PAC-3 MSE多年期合約——這正是10/22報告點名『今天財報應能看到框架協議轉實際合約的進度』這個查核點的答案，而答案是：用『多年期合約』這個字眼本身，就與10/19週報『2,000枚年產能要到2030年底』的判斷方向一致，沒有看到加速交付的訊號。利雅德機場這條線則相反——10/22報告具體寫下法國航空停飛到10/24這個可查核的日期，但查核當天(10/24)發現多家媒體對法航實際排班互相矛盾(一說10/24、一說10/31、一說原訂10/27)，連航空公司自己的時間表都無法用單一二手報導釘死，英國航空11/3這個數字倒是各方一致。政策端：白宮10/16簽署行政命令，引用《格雷姆法案》(Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act)第115條豁免權，無限期暫停原訂10/18生效的對俄500%關稅與對主要俄油買家100%關稅——豁免沒有到期日，只看總統或國務卿何時認定『有必要採取進一步行動』，背景是川普與普丁談成的柴油供應換制裁解除協議。這與10/16報告追蹤的BIS Affiliates Rule(11/10法定到期、行政命令至今未公布)用的是同一套機制——差別在於格雷姆法案這次連『到期日』本身都被拿掉了，比『推遲到期日』更進一步，9/26報告與10/2月報建立的『到期日變成籌碼』判斷這次不只站得住，還出現了比原判斷更極端的版本。技術端：白宮OMB備忘錄M-26-15訂下的聯邦機關後量子密碼遷移計畫繳交期限(備忘錄發布後120天)落在10/22，是否如期繳交、繳交品質如何，目前查無公開資訊可查核。本期nexus把ARTEX案例與PQC遷移時程並讀：前者顯示攻擊端已經把『鎖定目標到取得特權存取』壓縮到以分鐘、小時計算，後者顯示面對量子運算這個同樣被視為典範轉移級威脅，聯邦體制給自己的時程卻是以『年』為單位(到2030年才『視可行性』減緩風險、2035年才全面完成)——但也要誠實註記反例：Trend Micro的Dustin Childs今年稍早即指出，儘管CVE與AI輔助找洞數量暴增，CISA的KEV(已遭利用)目錄並未出現對應幅度的成長，意味著『攻擊端執行速度變快』與『整體入侵成功率同步攀升』是兩件還不能劃上等號的事，本期的ARTEX案例本身屬於前者的證據，不能直接當成後者已經發生的證明。
focus.en: This period covers 10/22-10/24. Cyber: Microsoft's security blog revealed on 10/21 that the China-state-aligned actor Storm-0940 compromised credentials for ConnectWise Cloud Backup, a multi-tenant application, and used IP range 144.172.64.x to attempt sign-ins against more than 2,250 downstream M365 tenants — in several cases going from initial targeting to privileged access in under 3 hours, at one point completing 200+ sign-ins in under 4 minutes with 4 application credentials. Independent incident-response vendor Huntress separately observed 1,000+ Entra tenants targeted and 300+ confirmed compromised from its own customer base, cross-confirming Microsoft's own figures. The tool used is ARTEX, the exact one this site logged in its 10/10 report — then, the recorded incident was a financially motivated actor chaining it to Claude Code against South Korean financial institutions; this is the first confirmed case of the same tool used by a state actor at MSP supply-chain scale. Separately, PHP's core team shipped emergency patches on 10/21 for two CVSS-9.2 unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, nicknamed 'PHP2Shell' by media) affecting nearly every PHP version, with vendors estimating potential exposure at 70% of PHP-powered sites; watchTowr independently reproduced one flaw, and multiple security vendors observed scanning/exploitation attempts the same day patches shipped, though no confirmed mass-compromise incident has surfaced yet. Military-industrial: Lockheed Martin's Q3 2026 earnings, released 10/22, show backlog hitting a record $292.0B (up from Q2's $230.4B), with $52.5B tied to a PAC-3 MSE multi-year award — this is the direct answer to the checkpoint the 10/22 report flagged ('today's earnings should show how the framework agreement is converting into actual contracts'), and the answer is that the very phrase 'multi-year award' points the same direction as the 10/19 weekly's '2,000/year capacity won't arrive until end of 2030' judgment, with no sign of accelerated delivery. The Riyadh airport thread runs the opposite way — the 10/22 report gave a specific, checkable date (Air France grounded through 10/24), but checking today (10/24) finds multiple outlets reporting contradictory versions of Air France's actual schedule (10/24, 10/31, and an originally-planned 10/27 all appear), meaning even the airline's own timetable can't be pinned down from a single secondary report; British Airways' 11/3 figure is the one consistent number across sources. Policy: the White House signed an executive order on 10/16 invoking Section 115 waiver authority under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act to indefinitely suspend 500% tariffs on Russia and 100% tariffs on major buyers of Russian oil that were set to take effect 10/18 — the waiver carries no expiration date, lasting only until the president or Secretary of State determines 'further action is necessary,' against the backdrop of a Trump-Putin diesel-for-sanctions-relief arrangement. This uses the same mechanism as the BIS Affiliates Rule tracked since the 10/16 report (legally due to expire 11/10, with no extension notice published) — except here, the Graham Act waiver removes the concept of a deadline entirely, going a step beyond merely delaying one. The 9/26 report's and 10/2 monthly's 'deadlines become currency' judgment doesn't just hold here — it gets a more extreme version than originally framed. Tech: the federal PQC migration-plan deadline set by OMB Memorandum M-26-15 (120 days after issuance) landed on 10/22, and no public information was found on whether agencies met it or the quality of what was submitted. This period's nexus item reads the ARTEX case against the PQC migration timeline: the former shows attackers have compressed 'target to privileged access' to minutes and hours, while the latter shows that facing quantum computing — a threat regarded as equally paradigm-shifting — the federal system's self-set timeline runs in years (mitigate risk 'as feasible' only by 2030, complete migration only by 2035). An honest counterpoint must be noted too: Trend Micro's Dustin Childs pointed out earlier this year that despite the surge in CVE counts and AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, CISA's KEV (actually-exploited) catalog hasn't shown a corresponding rise — meaning 'attacker execution speed is increasing' (what this period's ARTEX case evidences) and 'overall breach success rate is rising in lockstep' (not yet shown by aggregate data) are two claims that can't yet be equated.

title.zh: 微軟揭露Storm-0940用ARTEX自主滲透工具攻破ConnectWise供應鏈，鎖定逾2,250個下游M365租戶——本站10/10報告收錄的同一款工具，首次被證實用在國家級行為者的MSP供應鏈規模攻擊
title.en: Microsoft exposes Storm-0940 using the autonomous pentesting tool ARTEX to breach ConnectWise's supply chain, targeting 2,250+ downstream M365 tenants — the same tool this site tracked on 10/10, now confirmed used by a state actor at MSP supply-chain scale for the first time

summary.zh: 微軟資安部落格10/21公布調查結果：中國國家背景駭客集團Storm-0940(自2021年活躍，以竊資料為主，過去慣用密碼噴灑與邊界應用程式漏洞)取得ConnectWise Cloud Backup(一款多租戶雲端備份應用)的應用程式憑證後，透過IP位址段144.172.64.x，用竊得的憑證對超過2,250個下游Microsoft 365租戶嘗試登入，部分環境內的攻擊代理在不到3小時內就從初始鎖定推進到具特權的雲端存取，其中一次攻擊在不到4分鐘內用4組應用程式憑證完成逾200次登入。觀測到的入侵後行為包括：新增應用程式憑證以維持存續、調整app-role指派、至少一起個案是某ConnectWise管理應用程式自行把自己指派為Global Administrator、以及對多個Azure Key Vault進行批次密鑰讀取與列舉。微軟表示多數鎖定嘗試並未成功，但確認攻擊者在『多個組織』取得了具特權的雲端持久性，未公布具體淪陷組織數；獨立事件應變廠商Huntress則從自家客戶觀測到逾1,000個Entra租戶遭鎖定、其中逾300個確認遭入侵，兩家廠商從不同角度得出互相獨立卻方向一致的規模估計。另查到10/10-10/14一波密碼噴灑(IP 144.172.64.99)，鎖定8個組織的327個帳號，產生逾15.1萬次失敗登入(10/11單日尖峰達每分鐘2,900次失敗)，但這波噴灑本身未觀測到任何一次成功驗證。ConnectWise已於10/16發布初步公告，10/18進一步把SaaS Security與Cloud Management服務一併下線，但表示目前沒有證據顯示備份資料本身遭存取；該公司至今未說明攻擊者最初是如何取得其應用程式憑證。攻擊工具ARTEX是一款以Go撰寫、Next.js前端的開源多代理LLM滲透測試框架，可自主完成從偵察到資料外洩的整條鏈，介面預設英文但可切換韓文、中文、西班牙文、日文——正是本站10/10報告收錄的同一款工具，當時記錄的事件是財務動機駭客將其與Anthropic Claude Code串接入侵南韓金融機構。
summary.en: Microsoft's security blog published findings on 10/21: Storm-0940, a China-state-aligned actor active since 2021 focused on data theft (historically using password spraying and internet-facing application exploits), obtained application credentials for ConnectWise Cloud Backup — a multi-tenant cloud backup application — and used them from IP range 144.172.64.x to attempt sign-ins to more than 2,250 downstream Microsoft 365 tenants. In some environments, the attack's agents went from initial targeting to privileged cloud access in under 3 hours; in one case, over 200 sign-ins were completed in under 4 minutes using 4 application credentials. Observed post-compromise behavior included adding application credentials for persistence, modifying app-role assignments, at least one case of a ConnectWise management application self-assigning the Global Administrator role, and bulk reads/enumeration of secrets across multiple Azure Key Vaults. Microsoft says most targeting attempts failed, but confirmed the attacker achieved privileged cloud persistence at 'many organizations' without disclosing an exact compromised count; independent incident-response vendor Huntress separately observed over 1,000 Entra tenants targeted from its own customer base, with 300+ confirmed compromised — two independent vendors arriving at consistent-scale estimates from different vantage points. A password-spray wave from 10/10-10/14 (IP 144.172.64.99) targeted 327 accounts across 8 organizations, generating 151,000+ failed logons (peaking at 2,900 failures/minute on 10/11), though this specific spray recorded zero successful authentications. ConnectWise published an initial advisory on 10/16 and, on 10/18, took its SaaS Security and Cloud Management services offline as well, saying there's no evidence backup data itself was accessed; the company still hasn't explained how its application credentials were initially obtained. The attack tool, ARTEX, is an open-source multi-agent LLM pentesting framework written in Go with a Next.js frontend that can autonomously run an entire chain from reconnaissance to exfiltration, defaulting to English but switchable to Korean, Mandarin, Spanish, or Japanese — the exact tool this site tracked in its 10/10 report, where the recorded incident involved a financially motivated actor chaining it to Anthropic's Claude Code to breach South Korean financial institutions.

implication.zh: 本站10/10報告建立ARTEX這個詞條時，記錄的樣本是單一財務動機駭客串接Claude Code打南韓金融機構——當時的威脅模型是『犯罪集團用AI代理降低技術門檻』。這次Storm-0940的案例把同一套工具的使用場景升級了兩個維度：第一，行為者從財務動機換成國家級(中國國家背景)；第二，入侵路徑從直接打目標企業換成MSP供應鏈——拿下一家雲端備份服務商的應用程式憑證，等於同時拿到對2,250個下游租戶嘗試存取的槓桿，目標產業橫跨航太、國防、半導體、能源、金融、政府與軍工，與本站長期追蹤的RMM平台供應鏈風險(AhsayCBS等案例)屬同一種結構，只是這次的放大器換成了自主AI代理。對你做威脅獵捕與provenance graph建模的操作意義最直接：『從初始鎖定到具特權存取不到3小時、4分鐘內200次登入』這組數字，代表傳統依賴『異常時間窗』(例如非上班時間大量登入)的偵測邏輯正在失效——人類分析師習慣用小時甚至天為單位去審視告警佇列，但這起案例的整條攻擊鏈可以在你還沒看完一次例行巡檢前就執行完畢。更值得記住的是方法論意義：當一個組織把高權限委派給第三方SaaS應用程式(這裡是備份服務的既有授權)，這個委派關係本身就是一個需要被同等看重的攻擊面，不亞於你自己環境裡的帳號與端點——而且使用者端幾乎沒有能力單方面偵測這類攻擊，因為登入來源用的是合法的、過去就已核准的應用程式身分。
implication.en: When this site first logged ARTEX in its 10/10 report, the tracked sample was a single financially motivated actor chaining it to Claude Code against South Korean financial institutions — the threat model at the time was 'criminal groups using AI agents to lower the technical bar.' The Storm-0940 case upgrades that same tool's use case along two axes: first, the actor shifts from financially motivated to state-level (China-aligned); second, the path shifts from direct targeting to MSP supply chain — compromising one cloud-backup vendor's application credentials bought leverage to attempt access across 2,250 downstream tenants, spanning aerospace, defense, semiconductors, energy, finance, government, and military sectors. Structurally this is the same class of risk this site has tracked in RMM-platform supply chains (e.g., the AhsayCBS case) — except the force multiplier here is an autonomous AI agent rather than a human operator. For threat-hunting and provenance-graph modeling, the most directly actionable number is this: under 3 hours from initial targeting to privileged access, 200 sign-ins in under 4 minutes. That means detection logic built around 'anomalous time windows' (e.g., mass logins outside business hours) is losing relevance — human analysts are used to reviewing alert queues on an hourly-to-daily cadence, but this entire attack chain can complete before you finish one routine sweep. The deeper methodological point: when an organization delegates high privilege to a third-party SaaS application (here, a backup service's pre-existing authorization), that delegation relationship is itself an attack surface that deserves the same weight as your own accounts and endpoints — and the victim organization has almost no unilateral way to detect this category of attack, because the sign-in source is a legitimate, previously-approved application identity.

counterpoint.zh: 微軟與Huntress給出的受害組織規模數字並不一致(微軟只說『多個組織』取得特權持久性，未給出確切數字；Huntress從自家客群觀測到逾300個確認淪陷)，兩者樣本基礎(微軟的全租戶遙測 vs. Huntress的客戶群)本來就不同，不能直接相加或互相校驗；ConnectWise本身也尚未公開說明最初的應用程式憑證是如何外洩的，攻擊的根源問題目前仍是未知數。
counterpoint.en: Microsoft and Huntress give inconsistent scale figures (Microsoft only says 'many organizations' achieved privileged persistence without a precise count; Huntress separately observed 300+ confirmed compromises from its own customer base) — the two vendors' sample bases (Microsoft's tenant-wide telemetry vs. Huntress's customer set) aren't directly comparable or additive. ConnectWise itself still hasn't disclosed how its application credentials were originally obtained, so the root cause of the breach remains unknown.

items.source: Microsoft Security Blog（官方調查報告，10/21）、Huntress事件應變部落格

title.zh: PHP核心爆兩個CVSS 9.2未經驗證RCE，媒體稱『PHP2Shell』——幾乎涵蓋所有歷史版本，廠商估計潛在曝險達全球PHP網站七成
title.en: PHP core hit by two CVSS-9.2 unauthenticated RCE flaws dubbed 'PHP2Shell' — covering nearly every historical release, with vendors estimating exposure across 70% of PHP-powered sites

summary.zh: PHP核心團隊10/21緊急發布修補，因兩個漏洞細節在原訂揭露時程前遭外洩。CVE-2026-109618源於記憶體不足時的狀態毀損、CVE-2026-109619源於請求異常結束時殘留的全域狀態，兩者都是未經身分驗證、CVSS v4.0評分9.2的遠端程式碼執行漏洞，影響PHP-FPM、Apache mod_php、php-cgi、FrankenPHP、LiteSpeed等幾乎所有常見部署方式，且回溯影響歷史上幾乎所有PHP版本。PHP官方特別點名mod_php風險最高——攻擊者甚至不需要應用程式本身的程式碼先執行，一個未經驗證的請求就能觸發。修補版本為PHP 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36、8.2.35，官方明確表示沒有暫時緩解措施，更新是唯一辦法。資安研究機構watchTowr已獨立重現CVE-2026-109618，確認漏洞真實存在；多家資安廠商(Patchstack、Cloudflare、Fastly、Vega)在修補發布當天就觀測到掃描與攻擊嘗試，部分業者評估全球潛在曝險站台可達PHP網站總數的七成，但截至目前查核，尚未看到任何一起被證實的大規模入侵或資料外洩案例。
summary.en: PHP's core team shipped emergency patches on 10/21 after vulnerability details leaked ahead of the planned disclosure schedule. CVE-2026-109618 stems from memory corruption under out-of-memory conditions, and CVE-2026-109619 from stale global state left behind when a request terminates abnormally; both are unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaws scored CVSS v4.0 9.2, affecting PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, and LiteSpeed — essentially every common deployment mode — and retroactively affecting nearly every historical PHP release. PHP's own advisory specifically flags mod_php as highest-risk: an unauthenticated request can trigger the flaw before any application code even runs. Fixed versions are PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35; the vendor states explicitly there is no temporary mitigation — updating is the only option. Security research firm watchTowr independently reproduced CVE-2026-109618, confirming the flaw is real; multiple security vendors (Patchstack, Cloudflare, Fastly, Vega) observed scanning and exploitation attempts the same day the patches shipped, with some estimating potential global exposure at up to 70% of all PHP-powered sites — though as of this check, no confirmed large-scale breach or data-exfiltration incident has surfaced.

implication.zh: 這起漏洞的性質跟本站長期追蹤的Tier-0邊界設備系列(NetScaler、Cisco FMC、Ivanti Connect Secure、PAN-OS)不同——那一系列談的是少數幾款昂貴、企業級邊界設備被高度資源化的攻擊者鎖定；PHP則是網路上最大宗的伺服器端語言之一，影響面是『量』而非『質』：CVSS 9.2加上回溯幾乎所有版本的組合，意味著真正決定風險大小的不是漏洞本身的技術難度，而是全球有多少站台會在合理時間內完成更新——歷史經驗(例如log4j)顯示，這類『影響面廣、修補動作簡單』的漏洞，往往在發布後數週到數月內仍能找到大量未修補的目標，因為長尾站台的維運者未必會追蹤PHP核心的資安公告。對你評估供應鏈/第三方風險的操作意義：如果你在做滲透測試或防禦規劃時，PHP版本本身應該被當成一個需要主動盤點的資產屬性，而不是假設『用PHP的網站自己會處理』；對威脅獵捕而言，接下來幾週值得關注的不是這個漏洞本身是否被證實大規模利用，而是它會不會被打包進自動化掃描工具的常態掃描清單——一旦進入這個清單，長尾曝險站台被鎖定就只是時間問題，不需要攻擊者投入額外研發資源。
implication.en: This vulnerability is a different animal from the Tier-0 border-device series this site has tracked (NetScaler, Cisco FMC, Ivanti Connect Secure, PAN-OS) — those involve a handful of expensive, enterprise-grade perimeter devices targeted by well-resourced actors. PHP is one of the most common server-side languages on the internet; the impact here is about volume, not technical sophistication: a CVSS 9.2 score combined with retroactive impact on nearly every version means the real risk driver isn't the flaw's technical difficulty but how many sites worldwide actually patch within a reasonable window. History (e.g., Log4j) shows that this class of vulnerability — broad impact, simple fix — often still finds large numbers of unpatched targets weeks to months after disclosure, because long-tail site operators don't necessarily track PHP's own security advisories. For assessing supply-chain/third-party risk: if you're doing pentesting or defense planning, PHP version should be treated as an asset attribute that requires active inventory, not something you assume 'PHP-using sites will handle themselves.' For threat hunting, the thing worth watching over the coming weeks isn't whether this specific flaw gets confirmed at mass scale, but whether it gets folded into automated scanners' standard target lists — once that happens, long-tail exposed sites being hit becomes a matter of time, requiring no additional attacker R&D investment.

items.source: PHP官方資安公告（經Tanium、VulnCheck、Huntress、BleepingComputer轉述，watchTowr獨立重現CVE-2026-109618確認）

title.zh: 洛馬Q3財報：積壓訂單再創新高2,920億美元、525億美元明確掛在PAC-3 MSE多年期合約下——10/22報告點名的查核點有了答案，2030時間表沒有被加速
title.en: Lockheed's Q3 results: record $292.0B backlog, with $52.5B explicitly tied to a PAC-3 MSE multi-year award — the checkpoint the 10/22 report flagged now has an answer, and the 2030 timeline isn't accelerating

summary.zh: 洛克希德馬丁10/22公布Q3 2026財報：營收年增11%達207億美元，淨利18億美元(每股7.97美元)，營運現金流34億美元、自由現金流30億美元。公司總積壓訂單創歷史新高來到2,920億美元，較Q2結算的2,304億美元再跳升616億美元，其中明確點名525億美元屬於PAC-3 MSE(分段增強型)攔截彈的多年期採購合約。這正是10/22報告寫下的查核點——當時明確記錄『洛馬Q3財報排定10/22公布，屆時應能看到框架協議轉為確定訂單的實際進度』。查核結果顯示，積壓訂單確實持續轉換為具體合約，但轉換出來的合約形式是『多年期採購』，而非能顯示加速交付的短週期訂單；本次查核未取得Q3財報電話會議對THAAD產能或PAC-3年產能(600衝2,000)時程的具體最新說法，也沒有找到官方對AMPAC第二條過氯酸銨產線認證進度的更新。
summary.en: Lockheed Martin released its Q3 2026 results on 10/22: sales rose 11% year-over-year to $20.7B, net earnings of $1.8B ($7.97/share), $3.4B operating cash flow and $3.0B free cash flow. Total backlog hit a record $292.0B, up $61.6B from Q2's $230.4B, with $52.5B explicitly attributed to a multi-year PAC-3 MSE (Missile Segment Enhancement) interceptor procurement award. This is exactly the checkpoint the 10/22 report flagged, which noted 'Lockheed's Q3 earnings land today, 10/22, which should show how much of the framework agreement has converted into definitive contracts.' The result: backlog is indeed continuing to convert into concrete contracts, but the form that conversion takes is a multi-year procurement award, not a short-cycle order that would signal accelerated delivery. This check did not surface specific updated language from the Q3 earnings call on THAAD capacity or the PAC-3 600-to-2,000/year timeline, nor any official update on AMPAC's second ammonium-perchlorate line certification progress.

implication.zh: 10/19週報建立的核心判斷是『2,000枚年產能要到2030年底才到得了，因為是認證的函數，不是錢的函數』。這次的查核結果不是推翻，也不是加碼確認，而是落在『站得住、但沒有新證據』這個中間地帶——積壓訂單從2,304億美元跳升到2,920億美元，表面數字看起來很驚人，但支撐這個跳升的是一筆『多年期』採購合約，而『多年期』這個合約形式本身就隱含多年交付排程，與『加速在2028年前把產能衝上去』的情境方向相反。對你做國防股操作的提醒：積壓訂單創新高本身會被市場解讀成利多消息，但如果你已經接受10/19週報的框架(瓶頸在認證而非資金)，這次的真正訊號應該是『合約規模成長≠交付曲線提前』——真正該追的三個數字(洛馬年度交付數、AMPAC第二條產線認證狀態、Boeing尋標器合約進度)，這次財報揭露都沒有更新，代表下一個真正的查核點要等Q3財報電話會議逐字稿或Q4財報，而不是這次的頭條數字。
implication.en: The 10/19 weekly's core judgment was that 2,000-unit annual capacity 'won't arrive until end of 2030, because it's a function of certification, not money.' This check neither overturns nor strongly reconfirms that — it lands in a middle zone of 'holds, but no new evidence either way.' The backlog jump from $230.4B to $292.0B looks dramatic on its face, but what's behind it is a multi-year procurement award — and 'multi-year' as a contract form itself implies a multi-year delivery schedule, running counter to any scenario of accelerating capacity before 2028. For defense-stock positioning: a record backlog will get read by the market as unambiguously bullish, but if you've already accepted the 10/19 weekly's framework (the bottleneck is certification, not money), the real signal here is that contract-size growth doesn't equal a pulled-forward delivery curve. The three numbers actually worth tracking (Lockheed's annual delivery count, AMPAC's second-line certification status, Boeing's seeker contract progress) weren't updated in this release — meaning the next real checkpoint is the Q3 call transcript or Q4 earnings, not today's headline figure.

title.zh: 10/22報告寫下『法航停飛到10/24』這個可查核的日期——查核當天(10/24)發現連航空公司自己的時間表，不同媒體都講不出同一個版本
title.en: The 10/22 report gave a checkable date — 'Air France grounded through 10/24' — but checking on 10/24 itself finds even the airline's own schedule can't be pinned to one consistent version across sources

summary.zh: 10/22報告記錄的是：法國航空暫停利雅德航班延至10/24、英國航空則要到11/3才恢復(有限班次)。今天(10/24)實際查核發現，法航的確切恢復日期在不同媒體報導中互相矛盾——部分10月初的報導寫『停飛到10/24』，一份約10/13的旅遊媒體更新寫『停飛到10/31含當日』，另一篇10/11的報導則引述『原訂10/27恢復』，三者無法調和，也沒有找到法航官方公告頁面直接確認今天的實際狀態。相對之下，英國航空11/3這個數字是所有來源中唯一一致的。
summary.en: The 10/22 report recorded: Air France's Riyadh suspension extended to 10/24, British Airways not resuming (limited service) until 11/3. Checking today (10/24), Air France's exact resumption date turns out to be inconsistently reported across outlets — some early-October reporting says 'suspended through 10/24,' a travel-media update from around 10/13 says 'suspended through and including 10/31,' and another 10/11 piece cites 'originally planned to resume 10/27' — the three can't be reconciled, and no Air France official schedule page was found to directly confirm today's actual status. By contrast, British Airways' 11/3 figure is the one number consistent across every source.

implication.zh: 10/22報告在利雅德機場這條線上已經建立一個方法論判斷：『不要用機場宣布重開當作風險解除訊號，該追的是航空公司實際排班』。這次按照這個方法論去查核，得到一個比預期更尖銳的結果——連『航空公司實際排班』本身，都不是一個能從單一二手報導釘死的穩定訊號，因為媒體對同一家航空公司同一條航線的復飛日期，本身就存在至少三個互相矛盾的版本，差距橫跨超過兩週(10/24到10/31)。這對你的操作意義是把10/22報告的方法論再往前推一步：真正可靠的查核方式不是『找一篇提到法航時間表的報導』，而是直接比對法航官方訂票系統當下是否能訂到利雅德航班、或法航官方社群帳號的公告——任何依賴單一媒體轉述的『某航空公司將於X日恢復』這類陳述，在波灣風險這種快速變動的情境下，本身的可信度就該被打折扣，這個教訓比機場本身是否重開更具有可複用的價值。
implication.en: The 10/22 report already established a methodological judgment on the Riyadh airport thread: don't treat an announced reopening as a risk-cleared signal — track actual airline schedules instead. Applying that same methodology here produces a sharper-than-expected result: even 'actual airline schedules' turn out not to be a stable signal pinnable from a single secondary report, because media accounts of the same airline's resumption date for the same route carry at least three mutually contradictory versions spanning more than two weeks (10/24 to 10/31). The operational takeaway is to push the 10/22 report's methodology one step further: the reliable way to check this isn't 'find an article that mentions Air France's schedule' — it's directly checking whether Air France's own booking system currently sells Riyadh flights, or checking the airline's own official social announcements. Any statement of the form 'airline X resumes on date Y' sourced only through secondary media should be discounted by default in a fast-moving Gulf-risk situation like this — that lesson is more reusable than whether the airport itself has reopened.

items.source: Wego、The National等旅遊媒體（查核日10/24，多個版本互相矛盾）

title.zh: 川普10/16簽署行政命令，無限期豁免《格雷姆法案》對俄制裁——比『推遲到期日』更進一步，9/26報告『到期日變成籌碼』判斷這次出現更極端版本
title.en: Trump's 10/16 executive order indefinitely waives Graham Act sanctions on Russia — a step beyond 'pushing back the deadline,' giving the 9/26 report's 'deadlines become currency' judgment its most extreme version yet

summary.zh: 白宮10/16簽署行政命令，引用《格雷姆法案》(Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act，今年9/18立法)第115條的總統豁免權，暫停原訂10/18生效的對俄額外500%進口關稅，以及對俄羅斯石油與天然氣前五大買家的100%關稅。與一般『延後生效日』的做法不同，這次豁免沒有設定任何到期日——條文寫的是，豁免持續到總統或國務卿(會同財政部長、USTR)『認定有必要採取進一步行動』為止，等於把終止豁免的主動權完全留在行政部門手上。川普已依法向國會提交『豁免符合國家利益』的認證。背景是10/9生效的OFAC一般許可135號，授權俄羅斯柴油特定進口交易至2027/4/7，整起豁免被白宮框架為用柴油供應換取緩解美國國內油價壓力，批評者(包括法案起草人Blumenthal參議員)則稱此舉等於獎勵莫斯科、對降低油價效果有限。另一方面，《對俄進口石油禁止法》(Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act)對俄國油品的一般進口禁令並未受影響，仍然有效。與此同時，查核BIS Affiliates Rule(50%規則)的最新進度：一份追蹤2025/11/13至2026/9/23間BIS發布的65份聯邦公報文件的彙整顯示，沒有任何一份涉及延長或正式化這項暫停，法定狀態仍是11/10自動恢復——與10/16報告記錄的狀態相同，沒有新進展。
summary.en: The White House signed an executive order on 10/16 invoking Section 115's presidential waiver authority under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (enacted 9/18), suspending additional 500% import tariffs on Russia and 100% tariffs on the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas, originally set to take effect 10/18. Unlike a typical 'push back the effective date' move, this waiver sets no expiration at all — the text keeps it in effect until the president or the Secretary of State (in consultation with Treasury and USTR) determines further action is necessary, putting the sole power to end the waiver in the executive branch's hands. Trump has certified to Congress, as the law requires, that the waiver serves the national interest. The backdrop is OFAC General License 135, effective 10/9, authorizing specific Russian diesel import transactions through 4/7/2027 — the White House frames the whole waiver as trading diesel supply for relief from domestic US fuel-price pressure; critics, including the Act's own drafter Senator Blumenthal, call it a reward for Moscow with limited actual price impact. Separately, the Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act's general ban on Russian oil-product imports remains untouched and in force. Meanwhile, checking the BIS Affiliates Rule (the 50% ownership rule) for any update: a tracker covering all 65 Federal Register documents BIS published between 11/13/2025 and 9/23/2026 finds none that extends or formalizes the suspension — its legal status remains an automatic 11/10 reversion, unchanged from what the 10/16 report recorded, with no new development.

implication.zh: 9/26報告與10/2月報建立的判斷是『休兵不是解決爭端，是把爭端的到期日往後推、並讓到期日本身變成可以重新議價的籌碼』——這次的格雷姆法案案例不只驗證了這個判斷，還提供了一個比原判斷更極端的樣本：BIS Affiliates Rule的手法是『到期日還在，但行政部門遲遲不公布延長文件』，到期日本身仍然是一個未來某天會發生的事件；格雷姆法案的手法則是直接把『到期日』這個概念從機制裡拿掉，豁免只繫於行政部門主觀認定『有沒有必要採取進一步行動』，沒有任何時間錨點可以倒數。對你跟決策者對話時最有用的一句話是：這不是兩個獨立的個案，是同一套工具箱裡的兩種設定——『延遲公布』與『無限期豁免』都讓國會立法設定的強制措施，實際執行權力轉移到行政部門手上，差別只在於前者還留著一個名義上的到期日給外界追蹤、後者連這個名義座標都沒有了。對你判斷類似機制會不會也用在台灣相關的槓桿點(例如140億軍售、BIS出口管制)上，這給出一個可操作的預判：如果華府要對某個議題降溫但不想公開承認讓步，『無限期行政豁免』會是比『延遲到期日』更乾淨、更不需要後續被追蹤的工具，值得你在評估類似議題時把這個選項也列入可能性。
implication.en: The 9/26 report and 10/2 monthly established the judgment that a truce doesn't resolve a dispute — it pushes the dispute's deadline back and makes that deadline itself a renegotiable chip. The Graham Act case doesn't just confirm that judgment; it gives it a more extreme sample than the original. The BIS Affiliates Rule's mechanism is 'the deadline still exists, but the executive branch keeps not publishing the extension' — the deadline remains a future event that will eventually occur. The Graham Act waiver removes the concept of a deadline from the mechanism entirely: the waiver is contingent purely on the executive branch's subjective determination of whether 'further action is necessary,' with no time anchor to count down to at all. The most useful sentence for a conversation with decision-makers: these aren't two separate cases — they're two settings on the same toolkit. Both 'delayed publication' and 'indefinite waiver' transfer actual enforcement power for a congressionally mandated measure to the executive branch; the only difference is that the former still leaves a nominal deadline for outsiders to track, while the latter removes even that nominal coordinate. For judging whether the same mechanism might get applied to Taiwan-adjacent leverage points (the $14B arms sale, BIS export controls), this gives an actionable prediction: if Washington wants to cool down an issue without publicly admitting a concession, an indefinite executive waiver is a cleaner tool than delaying a deadline — one that requires no ongoing tracking by outsiders — and it's worth adding to the set of possibilities when you assess similar issues going forward.

counterpoint.zh: 格雷姆法案豁免針對的是對俄關稅與部分制裁條款，而非《對俄進口石油禁止法》這條獨立的俄油進口禁令，後者依然完整有效；因此不能把這次豁免解讀成『美國對俄制裁整體鬆動』，精確地說，這是『行政部門選擇性暫停了國會2026年9月才新通過、原訂10/18生效的加碼措施』，範圍比字面上的『豁免對俄制裁』要窄。
counterpoint.en: The Graham Act waiver targets tariffs and specific sanctions provisions on Russia, not the separate Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act's blanket ban on Russian oil imports, which remains fully in force. So this shouldn't be read as 'US sanctions on Russia broadly loosening' — more precisely, the executive branch selectively suspended a new escalation measure Congress had passed as recently as September 2026 and that was set to take effect 10/18; the scope is narrower than the headline 'waives Russia sanctions' framing suggests.

items.source: 白宮行政命令全文（經Clyde & Co、Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer法律簡報，AP/AFP通訊社轉述確認）

title.zh: 白宮OMB備忘錄M-26-15訂下的聯邦PQC遷移計畫繳交期限10/22屆至——有沒有如期繳交，目前查無公開資訊
title.en: The federal PQC migration-plan deadline set by OMB Memorandum M-26-15 landed on 10/22 — whether agencies actually met it remains publicly unverified

summary.zh: 白宮管理與預算局(OMB)於6/24發布備忘錄M-26-15《後量子密碼遷移執行令》，要求除國家安全系統外的所有聯邦機關，在備忘錄發布後120天內(即10/22，兩天前)向OMB與國家網路總監辦公室繳交後量子密碼遷移計畫，內容須涵蓋風險分級的系統優先順序、分階段時程、自動化加密盤點方法、加密靈活性架構、第三方協調、資源與人力預算、以及治理角色分工。備忘錄訂出的整體時程是：到2030年底前『視可行性』降低量子風險、到2035年完成全面遷移；國家安全系統則由另一套CNSA 2.0權責體系管轄，不在這份備忘錄範圍內。截至查核時間(10/24)，沒有找到任何公開資訊顯示各機關是否如期繳交計畫、繳交品質如何，或OMB是否已核發任何展延。
summary.en: The White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) issued Memorandum M-26-15, 'Execution of the Migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography,' on 6/24, requiring all federal agencies except National Security Systems to submit a PQC migration plan to OMB and the Office of the National Cyber Director within 120 days of issuance — landing on 10/22, two days before this check. The required plan content spans risk-based system prioritization, phased timelines, an automated cryptographic-inventory methodology, a crypto-agility architecture, third-party coordination, funding and staffing estimates, and governance roles. The memo's overall timeline: mitigate quantum risk 'as feasible' by end of 2030, complete full migration by 2035; National Security Systems fall under the separate CNSA 2.0 authority and aren't covered by this memo. As of this check (10/24), no public information was found on whether agencies actually met the deadline, the quality of what was submitted, or whether OMB has granted any extensions.

implication.zh: 這條線跟本站累積詞彙表裡『後量子密碼學』與『先竊後解』這兩個詞條直接相關——先前的報告記錄的多半是『威脅存在、對策尚早』這種定性描述，這次10/22是第一個具體、可查核的聯邦機關行動期限，值得你記下來當成之後的查核點。對你評估一個組織面對量子威脅的實際成熟度，這份備忘錄本身的結構給了一個可操作的框架：『有沒有做風險分級的系統盤點』與『有沒有自動化加密盤點工具』這兩項要求，恰好對應威脅獵捕與provenance graph研究裡最基礎的問題——你根本不可能保護你不知道自己擁有的加密資產。更值得持續追蹤的是，這份備忘錄把『降低風險』與『完成遷移』拆成兩個不同時間點(2030 vs 2035)，而且2030年的標準只是『視可行性』(as feasible)，本身就留了很大的解釋空間——如果屆時某機關的遷移計畫品質參差不齊，這個『視可行性』條款就會變成一個比法定期限本身更值得分析的灰色地帶，模式上與本站長期追蹤的『到期日變成籌碼』機制(見本期geo項目)有結構上的相似性，差別在於這裡的主角是官僚執行能力，不是政治談判槓桿。
implication.en: This connects directly to two terms in this site's accumulated glossary: post-quantum cryptography and 'harvest now, decrypt later.' Prior reports mostly carried qualitative framing — 'the threat exists, countermeasures are early-stage' — but 10/22 is the first concrete, checkable deadline for federal agency action, worth logging as a checkpoint to revisit. For assessing an organization's actual maturity against the quantum threat, the memo's own structure offers a usable framework: the requirements for risk-based system inventory and an automated cryptographic-inventory tool map directly onto the most basic question in threat hunting and provenance-graph work — you cannot protect a cryptographic asset you don't know you have. Worth continuing to track: the memo splits 'mitigate risk' and 'complete migration' into two separate dates (2030 vs. 2035), and the 2030 standard is only 'as feasible' — language that leaves considerable room for interpretation. If agency migration-plan quality turns out to be uneven, that 'as feasible' clause will likely become a more analytically interesting gray zone than the statutory deadline itself — structurally similar to the 'deadlines become currency' mechanism this site has tracked elsewhere (see this period's geo item), except the lead actor here is bureaucratic execution capacity, not political negotiating leverage.

title.zh: 本期數字對照：ARTEX把『鎖定目標到特權存取』壓到3小時內，聯邦PQC遷移時程卻以『年』計——攻守兩端的時間尺度，這次給出具體數字可比
title.en: This period's number to sit with: ARTEX compresses 'target to privileged access' to under 3 hours, while the federal PQC migration runs on a clock measured in years — attacker and defender tempo, now with concrete figures to compare

summary.zh: 本期cyber端的Storm-0940/ARTEX案例與tech端的OMB PQC遷移備忘錄，分屬完全不同的威脅類別(前者是現在進行式的帳密濫用攻擊，後者是為因應未來量子運算威脅的前瞻性密碼遷移)，彼此沒有直接因果關係，但兩者放在同一張時間尺度的圖上，會讀出一個值得你帶進決策者對話的量化對照：攻擊端這次給出的具體數字是『多個案例中，從初始鎖定到取得具特權雲端存取不到3小時』、『4分鐘內用4組憑證完成逾200次登入』；防守端(以聯邦體制作為樣本)這次給出的具體數字則是，面對普遍被視為典範轉移等級的量子運算威脅，官方給自己訂的時程是『到2030年底視可行性降低風險、到2035年完成全面遷移』——前者的時間單位是分鐘與小時，後者的時間單位是年。這不是在比較同一件事(帳密濫用與密碼遷移是兩種威脅)，而是在比較兩種制度回應同一類『威脅形態正在質變』的壓力時，各自展現出的反應速度量級差異。
summary.en: This period's cyber-side Storm-0940/ARTEX case and the tech-side OMB PQC migration memo belong to entirely different threat categories — one is an ongoing credential-abuse attack happening now, the other is forward-looking cryptographic migration planning for a future quantum-computing threat — and there's no direct causal link between them. But placed on the same timescale, they produce a quantified contrast worth bringing into a conversation with decision-makers: on the attacker side, this period's concrete numbers are 'under 3 hours from initial targeting to privileged cloud access in multiple cases' and 'over 200 sign-ins completed in 4 minutes using 4 credentials.' On the defender side (using the federal system as the sample), the concrete numbers are a self-set timeline of 'mitigate risk as feasible by end of 2030, complete full migration by 2035' in response to a threat widely regarded as civilization-scale — quantum computing. The attacker's unit of time is minutes and hours; the defender's is years. This isn't a comparison of the same threat (credential abuse and crypto migration are different things) — it's a comparison of the order-of-magnitude response speed two different institutional systems exhibit when facing the same underlying pressure: a threat landscape undergoing qualitative change.

implication.zh: 對你做威脅獵捕與decision-maker對話的操作意義，不是『防守方應該也用分鐘為單位行動』(這對密碼遷移這種需要跨系統、跨供應商協調的工程任務並不現實)，而是這個時間尺度的落差本身，應該被當成一個制度設計的輸入變數，而不是意外。當攻擊端的工具鏈(本例是ARTEX這類自主AI代理)把執行速度壓縮到分鐘等級時，任何依賴『人在迴圈中審核』的防禦機制，在這個時間尺度上都註定來不及反應——這代表防禦投資的優先順序應該往『在攻擊鏈還沒完成前，結構性地限制其能走多遠』傾斜(例如最小權限原則、第三方應用程式權限的強制逾期重新驗證)，而不是寄望偵測與人工研判能跟上分鐘等級的攻擊節奏。另一方面，10/5週報建立的『KEV/EPSS正在失去預測力，不是速度』這個判斷，這次需要加上一個誠實的但書：Trend Micro的Dustin Childs今年稍早已指出，儘管CVE與AI輔助找洞數量暴增，CISA的KEV(已遭利用)目錄並未出現對應幅度的成長——意味著『攻擊端執行速度變快』(本期ARTEX案例證實的)與『整體入侵成功率同步攀升』(目前彙總數據尚未證實)，是兩個還不能劃上等號的命題，前者是本期新增的確鑿證據，後者仍是待驗證的假說，你在跟決策者轉述這個判斷時，應該把這個區分講清楚，不要把兩者混為一談。
implication.en: The operational point for threat hunting and decision-maker conversations isn't that defenders should also operate on a minute-by-minute clock — that's unrealistic for an engineering task like crypto migration that requires cross-system, cross-vendor coordination. It's that this gap in timescale should itself be treated as a design input, not a surprise. When the attacker's toolchain (here, an autonomous AI agent like ARTEX) compresses execution speed to the minute scale, any defense mechanism that relies on a human in the loop is, at that timescale, structurally too slow to react — which means defensive investment priorities should tilt toward structurally limiting how far an attack chain can get before completion (least-privilege design, mandatory re-authorization expiry for third-party application permissions) rather than hoping detection and human triage can keep pace with minute-scale attack tempo. Separately, the 10/5 weekly's judgment that 'KEV/EPSS is losing predictive power, not speed' needs an honest caveat added this period: Trend Micro's Dustin Childs noted earlier this year that despite the surge in CVE counts and AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, CISA's KEV (actually-exploited) catalog hasn't shown a corresponding rise — meaning 'attacker execution speed is increasing' (confirmed this period by the ARTEX case) and 'overall breach success rate is rising in lockstep' (not yet confirmed by aggregate data) are two separate claims that can't yet be equated. The former is solid new evidence from this period; the latter remains an untested hypothesis, and when relaying this judgment to decision-makers, that distinction should be made explicit rather than conflated.
